title: Real-world and multimodal neuroimaging
summary: Simultaneously recording and modeling brain activity and body function, combining EEG, behavioral, and physiological measures such as ECG, EMG, eye-tracking, IMUs, and motion capture.
alt: MoBI laboratory with motion-capture cameras and a sensor suit on a stand

title: Computational modeling and EEG foundation models
summary: Applying independent component analysis, time-frequency analysis, statistical methods, and large brain foundation models to study the neural activity underlying cognition, perception, and awareness.
alt: Finite element head model meshes used for EEG source modeling

title: Next-generation, preventive brain-computer interfaces
summary: Developing and validating predictive and forecasting BCIs, with the long-term goal of preventive interfaces that improve the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of neurological diseases and injuries.
alt: Participant wearing a high-density EEG cap and motion-capture suit in the MoBI lab
